name: tweet_hate_v2

hostile_slur_at_woman.instructions: Is this tweet using a slur (bitch, hoe, cunt) as a hostile attack directed at a woman (individual or women as a group)? Exclude: affectionate use, self-reference, idioms, male targets, exclamations, or reporting misogyny.

degrade_immigrants_not_politics.instructions: Does the tweet's BODY degrade immigrants/migrants as criminals, animals, welfare drains, job thieves, or frame them as a threat/invasion/taking over the country? Exclude: political attacks on Democrats/Congress/politicians even if they mention immigration; policy discussions about legality, border funding, or legal immigration; and hashtag spam or off-topic uses.

description: Classify tweets as hateful based on policy: hate toward women via slurs or toward immigrants via dehumanization, not just hashtags
